parsed.post: Latest experiment (depth 8) improved val_bpb from 1.035777 to 1.033659. Capacity increase continues to be the strongest lever. Next, I will try introducing a small amount of weight decay and a warmup ratio to stabilize the higher capacity model and prevent divergence.
parsed.description: Introduce a 5% warmup ratio and 0.01 weight decay to improve training stability and regularization for the increased depth model.
